source_title: BCD Travel Data Breach Investigation: Edelson Lechtzin LLP Probes Class Action Claims After a Third-Party Attack Exposes Traveler Data
source_excerpt:
National class action law firm offers free, confidential case evaluations to BCD Travel travelers and others whose personal information may have been exposed.
NEWTOWN, Pa. , Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Edelson Lechtzin LLP , a national class action law firm, is investigating data privacy claims arising from a data breach at BCD Travel Services B.V., a global business travel management company that provides travel management, consulting, and related services to corporate clients and their travelers. Anyone who received a breach notice or believes their information may have been exposed can request a free case evaluation .
BCD Travel has notified affected individuals of a data security incident involving a third-party vulnerability that compromised personal information held in one of its applications. According to its notice, BCD Travel activated its cybersecurity incident response team, took the affected application offline, launched an in-depth investigation with third-party cybersecurity and forensic experts, implemented recommended security measures, and notified law enforcement. The company has said it remains fully operational and that, to date, it has not identified evidence that affected personal information has been misused.
The incident has drawn public attention after the threat-actor group ShinyHunters claimed responsibility in late May 2026 and threatened to leak more than 700,000 records unless the company met its demands. News coverage reports that the breach exposed personal data belonging to about 700,000 customers.
According to BCD Travel, the personal information involved may include:
Frequent flyer and loyalty program numbers
Because this information includes financial, identification, and travel details, the exposure creates a heightened risk of identity theft , payment fraud , and targeted phishing for affected individuals.
The investigation focuses on travelers whose personal information BCD Travel held in connection with the travel services it provides to corporate clients. BCD Travel is offering affected individuals one year of complimentary credit and identity fraud monitoring through Experian; eligible individuals can enroll using the activation code in their notification letter by the deadline stated in that letter.
Edelson Lechtzin LLP is investigating a potential class action on behalf of individuals whose data may have been compromised. A successful case could recover compensation for losses such as lost time, out-of-pocket costs, and loss of privacy, and could press BCD Travel to strengthen its data protection. The firm evaluates claims at no cost.
Watch for the notice from BCD Travel and keep the enclosed activation code for the complimentary Experian monitoring being offered.
Review your payment card and account statements closely, and stay alert for phishing emails, texts, or calls that reference your travel.
Place a free fraud alert or credit freeze with Equifax, Experian, and TransUnion, obtain your free reports at AnnualCreditReport.com, and report suspected identity theft to the Federal Trade Commission at IdentityTheft.gov.
Speak confidentially with a data privacy attorney: Marc Edelson, Esq., Edelson Lechtzin LLP , 411 S. State Street, Suite N-300, Newtown, PA 18940; Phone: 844-696-7492 ; Email: [email protected] ; or click HERE to request a free consultation.
Edelson Lechtzin LLP is a national class action law firm with offices in Pennsylvania and California. Beyond data breach litigation, the firm handles class and collective actions involving securities and investment fraud , antitrust violations, ERISA benefit plans, wage theft , and consumer fraud .
